messages:
Marco: FYI - MediCore wants Redwood onboarded as a marketplace offering + SI-managed private deployment. They're requesting an urgent architecture review because procurement flagged HSM compliance and marketplace listing deadlines. Can SI + platform do a joint call tomorrow?

Priya (SI): We can. Need clarity on HSM vendor: customer uses VaultSec HSM proxy and wants Redwood to do cert provisioning. Also flagged that marketplace listing requires proof of customer data isolation.

Anika: I'll run the arch review. Quick questions: do we require explicit VPC peering for marketplace images or can we use a managed private link?

SREOncall: Prefer private link for marketplace to avoid cross-AZ peering issues. Private link reduces blast radius and simplifies firewall rules. Need allowlist CIDRs from their infra team.

Marco: Procurement gave a hard deadline for marketplace submission: 7 days. Marketing wants a co-announcement window two weeks after listing. Legal needs to sign off on joint PR.

Maya (marketing): We need a short approval checklist: logos, quotes, customer opt-in. No announcement until SI confirms HSM integration and audit logging.

LegalBot: Reminder: customer NDA addendum required for public marketplace listing. Also need confirmation of data residency controls.

Priya (SI): Implementation note: initial tests failed during cert import. VaultSec proxy rewrites TLS SNI, which breaks our control-plane mTLS. They asked if we're willing to accept SNI rewrite or provide a relay.

Anika: Relay is possible but requires SRE support and ephemeral credentials flow. We should capture packet logs and VaultSec proxy config.

SREOncall: Ok to run a temporary relay in their VPC, but we need runbook steps and rollback plan. Also recommend canary with a single namespace and strict rate limits.

Marco: Can we meet tomorrow 9am PT? Agenda: 1) cert flow + packet logs 2) private link vs peering 3) marketplace gating items 4) announcement policy.

Maya (marketing): I'll prep draft announcement gating checklist and signals for go/no-go.

Anika: I'll bring a 1-page network diagram and list of k8s node sizing options. For the workload profile: sequence len ~800, bursty daytime traffic. Recommend g5.8x for Dedicated or A100 q8_0 for private.

Priya (SI): SI will provide VaultSec proxy config and vendor contact before the call. Also prepping deployment checklist.

SREOncall: I'll capture mTLS error traces and determine if SNI rewrite can be tolerated or if relay is required.

LegalBot: I'll start the NDA addendum draft and ask compliance for data residency confirmation.

Marco: Thanks all. Action items: Marco (coordinate call), Anika (diagram + sizing), Priya (VaultSec configs + SI checklist), SREOncall (mTLS logs + relay feasibility), Maya (announcement checklist), LegalBot (NDA). No public comms until legal + integration sign-off.

Priya (SI): Understood. We'll expedite on our side and share vendor contact. See you tomorrow. :wave:
